workflow_rationale: Multi-component feature requiring backend routing logic, orchestrator integration, cost tracking enhancement, and CLI interface. Follows service dependency order: routing core → orchestrator integration → cost reporting.

phases.name: Routing Matrix Core
phases.description: Build the core model routing matrix with 16 task types mapped to 4 cost tiers

subtasks.notes: Created cost_tiers.py with 4-tier model definitions (FRONTIER/MID/FAST/MINIMAL). Implemented ModelDefinition ValueObject with pricing, fallbacks, and context windows for 9 models across all tiers. Verification passed successfully.

subtasks.description: Create model_router.py with routing logic mapping task types to models

verification.command: python -c "from control_plane.core.routing.model_router import ModelRouter; r = ModelRouter(); print(r.get_model_for_task('bulk_triage_dedup'))"

subtasks.notes: Created model_router.py with ModelRouter class mapping 16 task types to optimal models across 4 cost tiers (FRONTIER/MID/FAST/MINIMAL). Implemented get_model_for_task(), get_model_definition(), estimate_cost() methods with support for operator overrides. Updated __init__.py to export ModelRouter. Verification passed successfully: bulk_triage_dedup correctly routes to deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.

Created RoutingConfig class for operator-specific model overrides. Implements environment variable loading (MODEL_OVERRIDE_<task_type>=<model_id>), task type validation against routing matrix, and clean interface for ModelRouter integration. Updated __init__.py to export RoutingConfig, ENV_PREFIX, and load_routing_config. All import and functional tests pass successfully.

subtasks.description: Add unit tests for model router
subtasks.notes: Created test_model_router.py with 49 unit tests covering: CostTier enum, ModelDefinition immutability, tier registries, get_model_by_tier, full 16-task routing matrix, operator overrides, get_model_definition, cost estimation, RoutingConfig env loading, validation, query helpers, factory function, whitespace stripping, copy semantics, tier coverage, fallbacks, free models, classvar verification. All 49 tests pass.

phases.name: Orchestrator Integration
phases.description: Integrate routing matrix into orchestrator to select models per agent task

subtasks.description: Add model selection logic to orchestrator based on task type

verification.instructions: Run orchestrator with DRYRUN=1 and verify model selection logs show correct routing

subtasks.notes: Added model routing to orchestrator: _AGENT_TASK_TYPE mapping (5 agents → task types), _init_model_router() with RoutingConfig override loading, _select_model() with logging, model_id parameter on _run_agent/phase functions, CLAUDE_MODEL env var injection. All routing verified: recon→gemini-3.1-pro, scanner→haiku-4-5, exploit→qwen3-coder, validator→opus-4-7, reporter→sonnet-4-6. Compilation verified.

subtasks.description: Add MODEL_OVERRIDE env var support for operator overrides
subtasks.notes: Added MODEL_OVERRIDE_<task_type> documentation to orchestrator docstring. The _init_model_router() already loads/applies overrides via RoutingConfig with runtime logging and graceful fallback. Verification passed: MODEL_OVERRIDE_recon env var correctly readable.

subtasks.description: Update agent launch to pass selected model via environment

verification.instructions: Launch recon agent and verify CLAUDE_MODEL env var is set

subtasks.notes: Verified: _run_agent() already accepts model_id param and sets CLAUDE_MODEL in merged_env (line 306). All 5 agent launch sites pass model_id through _run_agent. No code changes needed — implementation was completed as part of subtask-2-1.

phases.name: Enhanced Cost Tracking
phases.description: Enhance cost tracking to record task type and model per invocation

subtasks.description: Add task_type column to model_costs table
subtasks.notes: Created infra/sql/09_model_routing_tracking.sql adding task_type TEXT column to model_costs with IF NOT EXISTS idempotency. Added idx_model_costs_task_type_ts index on (task_type, ts DESC) for cost-by-task-type reporting. Committed as 87d4659.

Created v_cost_by_task_type view aggregating model_costs by task_type and model with invocation_count, total_cost_usd, avg_cost_usd, token usage, min/max timestamps. Fixed column names to use tokens_in/tokens_out (actual schema column names). Committed as 1676bd2.

phases.name: CLI Cost Reporting
phases.description: Add CLI command for cost breakdown by task type and model

verification.expected: Shows cost breakdown by task type

subtasks.notes: Added --by-task-type, --task-type, and --summary flags. New cmd_by_task_type() handler queries model_costs grouped by task_type with invocation_count, total/avg cost, token usage, and distinct models. Wired into _main() dispatch. Supports --since filtering. Syntax verified, argument parsing verified, help output confirmed. Committed as 11d6163.

Created scripts/cost_report.sh as a thin wrapper over cost_audit.py --by-task-type. Shows custom help with usage examples, forwards all args, uses uv when available. Verification passed. Committed as 1796b66.

phases.name: Integration Testing
phases.description: End-to-end verification of model routing with cost tracking

subtasks.description: Run full scan with routing enabled and verify cost < $0.20 per target

steps: Verify each agent uses correct model tier
Check model_costs table has task_type populated
Run cost-report and verify avg cost ≤ $0.20

Orchestrator selects models based on task type
Cost tracking records task_type per invocation
CLI cost report shows breakdown by task type
